wages.text: He helped lead Fairfax County's implementation of collective bargaining for employees.
wages.quote: Walkinshaw also helped lead county efforts to implement collective bargaining for employees, reduce plastic waste

trade.text: He criticized President Trump’s tariffs for raising prices and threatening Virginia jobs.
trade.quote: He is pushing back against President Trump’s tariffs that raise prices and threaten Virginia jobs

tax.text: He says he has spent 29 years studying how to cut taxes and argues for reducing demand rather than cutting programs.
tax.quote: As president of the Fairfax County Taxpayers Alliance, I've spent 29 years studying how to cut taxes.

debt.text: He strongly agreed that government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

schools.text: He says school districts should give vouchers to students who leave for private or home schooling.
schools.quote: School districts should give vouchers to students who attend for at least a year and then leave for private or home-schooling.

safety.text: In a questionnaire, Purves agreed that mandatory minimum sentences should be required and enforced for violent crimes.
safety.quote: Mandatory minimum sentencing should be required and enforced for violent crimes.

immigration.text: He calls for vetting immigrants before entry and barring traffickers and gang members.
immigration.quote: Do not let in the drug- and sex-traffickers and gang members from whom other immigrants are trying to flee.

guns.text: He argues that complex gun laws can turn law-abiding gun owners into inadvertent felons.
guns.quote: What's not debatable is that these laws turn law-abiding citizens into inadvertent felons.

abortion.text: He says abortion should remain legal only in rare cases to save the mother's life.
abortion.quote: Keep abortion legal for those rare cases but encourage marriage.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Purves strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or occupy women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces

health.text: He proposed reducing health-care costs through free-market pricing and consumer cost-sharing.
health.quote: Reduce healthcare costs by restoring free-market forces. Specifically, reduce premiums and eliminate fixed deductibles and co-pays

energy.text: He opposes carbon-credit policies that he says raise the cost of fossil fuels and gas.
energy.quote: Its only purpose is to drive up the cost of fossil fuel.

voting.text: He disagreed that people should be allowed to vote without photo identification and says mail-in ballots enable fraud.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification.

tax.text: Blais said federal programs cut by DOGE should be restored.
tax.quote: Many federal programs that were cut by DOGE should be reinstated.

wages.text: Blais said the minimum wage must be raised so full-time workers would not need federal assistance.
wages.quote: No full-time worker should need federal assistance so the minimum wage must be raised.

health.text: Blais said the country needs a national health care program.
health.quote: We badly need a national health care program.
